hitboxstudio.title: Hitbox Studio
hitboxstudio.header.using_default: This section uses the Default Style
hitboxstudio.button.cancel.tooltip: Undo every change made since opening Hitbox Studio.
hitboxstudio.page.general.tooltip: Hide with F1, max distance, and global line width / opacity.
hitboxstudio.page.default_style.tooltip: The look every entity section uses unless it has Custom Style turned on.
hitboxstudio.page.highlights.tooltip: Recolor hitboxes on crosshair target, in reach, or when hurt. End Crystals have their own on their page.
hitboxstudio.page.hidden_entities.toolti: Entity types that never get a hitbox, whatever section they're in.
hitboxstudio.category.crystals.info: End crystals. By default they skip the eye line and look arrow, which are useless on crystals.
hitboxstudio.category.players.info: Other players. Your own hitbox is under Self.
hitboxstudio.category.self.info: Your own hitbox. Like vanilla, only in third person (F5).
hitboxstudio.category.hostile.info: Anything that counts as a monster: zombies, skeletons, creepers, endermen, slimes, piglins, ghasts, the Ender Dragon, the Wither...
hitboxstudio.category.passive.info: Every other living mob: animals, villagers, golems, fish, bats...
hitboxstudio.category.xp_orbs.info: Experience orbs. Off by default since they're mostly clutter.
hitboxstudio.category.projectiles.info: Arrows, tridents, pearls, snowballs, potions, fireballs, wind charges, fireworks, fishing bobbers... Each type can be turned off on its own.
hitboxstudio.category.vehicles.info: Boats, rafts and every kind of minecart.
hitboxstudio.category.decorations.info: Item frames, glow item frames, paintings and leash knots.
hitboxstudio.category.other.info: Anything else: falling blocks, primed TNT, area effect clouds, evoker fangs, display entities...
hitboxstudio.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When OFF the normal vanilla F3+B hitboxes come back.
hitboxstudio.option.mode.tooltip:
With F3+B: only while F3+B is toggled on, like vanilla.
Always: no F3+B needed. Still hidden on servers that turn on reduced debug info.
hitboxstudio.option.hide_in_f1.tooltip: Hide all hitboxes while the HUD is hidden with F1. Vanilla keeps showing them.
hitboxstudio.option.max_distance.tooltip: Only draw hitboxes within this many blocks. All the way right is Unlimited. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.line_width_multiplie: Multiplies every line in every section. Lower it to thin everything out at once. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.opacity_multiplier.t: Multiplies the opacity of every line and fill. Lower it to fade everything at once. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.color.tooltip: Click to open the color wheel. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.highlight_color.tool: Replaces (or mixes with) the outline color while this is active. Click for the color wheel, right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.width.tooltip: Line thickness in pixels (vanilla is 2.5). Under 1 px the line fades instead of breaking into dots. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.size.tooltip: Dot size in pixels (vanilla is 2.0). Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.opacity.tooltip: How see-through this is. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.fill_opacity.tooltip: How see-through the fill is. Keep it low so you can still see the entity. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.box_expand.tooltip: Draws the box bigger or smaller than the real hitbox. Visual only, the real hitbox never changes. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.look_length.tooltip: How far the look arrow sticks out (vanilla is 2 blocks). Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.option.look_arrow_head.tool: The little tip at the end of the arrow. OFF gives a plain line.
hitboxstudio.option.blend_mode.tooltip:
Replace: the highlight color replaces the outline color.
Mix: a 50/50 mix of both.
hitboxstudio.option.apply_to_fill.toolti: Highlights recolor the fill too, not just the outline. The fill keeps its own opacity.
hitboxstudio.option.custom_style.tooltip:
OFF: this section uses the Default Style.
ON: this section gets its own full style.
hitboxstudio.option.copy_default.tooltip: Replace this section's style with a copy of the current Default Style. Asks first.
hitboxstudio.option.crystal_target.toolt: Recolor the crystal your crosshair is on.
hitboxstudio.option.crystal_in_reach.too: Recolor crystals you can reach, using your real reach (3 blocks in survival, more in creative or with attribute changes).
hitboxstudio.option.hidden_add.tooltip: Type an entity ID and press Add or Enter. "bat" works the same as "minecraft:bat". Modded IDs work too.
hitboxstudio.option.hidden_entry.tooltip: Show hitboxes for this entity again.
hitboxstudio.part.box.tooltip: The main bounding box (white in vanilla).
hitboxstudio.part.fill.tooltip: See-through faces filling the box. Not in vanilla, OFF by default.
hitboxstudio.part.eye_line.tooltip: The thin rectangle at eye level (red in vanilla). Only drawn on living entities, like vanilla.
hitboxstudio.part.look_vector.tooltip: The arrow pointing where the entity is looking (blue in vanilla).
hitboxstudio.part.position_dot.tooltip: The small dot at the entity's exact position, between its feet (white in vanilla).
hitboxstudio.part.ride_seat.tooltip: The flat box showing where a passenger sits on its vehicle or mount (yellow in vanilla).
hitboxstudio.part.multipart.tooltip: The extra boxes for each Ender Dragon body part (green in vanilla).
hitboxstudio.highlight.target.tooltip: Recolor the entity your crosshair is on.
hitboxstudio.highlight.in_reach.tooltip: Recolor entities you can reach (your real entity interaction range).
hitboxstudio.highlight.hurt.tooltip: Recolor mobs and players for the half second after they take damage.
hitboxstudio.projectile.arrows.tooltip: Arrows and spectral arrows, including tipped arrows.
hitboxstudio.projectile.potions.tooltip: Thrown splash and lingering potions, and bottles o' enchanting.
hitboxstudio.projectile.fireballs.toolti: Ghast fireballs, fire charges, dragon fireballs and wither skulls.
hitboxstudio.projectile.wind_charges.too: Wind charges from players and breezes.
hitboxstudio.projectile.other_projectile: Shulker bullets, llama spit, and projectiles from other mods.
hitboxstudio.confirm.reset_all.title: Reset all Hitbox Studio settings?
hitboxstudio.confirm.reset_all.message: Everything goes back to the vanilla-looking defaults. You can still press Cancel on the main Hitbox Studio screen to undo it.
hitboxstudio.confirm.reset_section.title: Reset this page?
hitboxstudio.confirm.copy_default.title: Copy the Default Style?
hitboxstudio.confirm.copy_default.messag: The custom style for %s is replaced with a copy of the current Default Style.
hitboxstudio.picker.title: Color: %s
hitboxstudio.picker.hex.tooltip: Type a color as #RRGGBB, or #AARRGGBB to include opacity.
hitboxstudio.picker.opacity.tooltip: How see-through this color is. Right-click to reset.
hitboxstudio.picker.rainbow.tooltip: Cycle through every color over time. Opacity still applies.
hitboxstudio.picker.old.tooltip: Click to go back to the old color
hitboxstudio.picker.recent_none: Colors you pick show up here.
hitboxstudio.preview.title: Preview: %s
